title: crataegus oxyacantha subvar. eriocarpa
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha subvar. eriocarpa, commonly known as Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe and Western Asia, with thorny branches and white or pink flowers. The health benefits of Hawthorn include its ability to improve cardiovascular health, reduce blood pressure, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawthorn include its vasodilatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating heart conditions and high blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of Hawthorn include flavonoids, such as quercetin and epicatechin, as well as oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
